title: Section-normalized consecutive scalar square for fixed realization
statement: Let f:Z→X be a scheme morphism and d an adic coefficient datum on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write B_n for the completion quotient and q_n:B_(n+1)→B_n [def-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent-data]. Define the ordinary fixed realization F_n by restriction along A/I^(n+1)→B_n followed by the prescribed associated-module-sheaf functor on Z. There exists a unique isomorphism c_n:Res(q_n) followed by F_(n+1) ≅ F_n followed by restriction along the actual pulled quotient map for which the underlying abelian-sheaf map is the identity after the canonical abelian sheafification counits. These counits define the predicate LisseTowerScalarSquareSections; it fixes c_n uniquely. Localize this square, compose with the comparison coefficient square and the fixed composition comparisons, obtaining lisseTowerEtaleScalarIso. For any adic tower M [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], bounded etale B_(n+1)- and B_n-complexes C,Cprime, and supplied level comparison isomorphisms e,eprime to the pulled actual levels M_(n+1),M_n, any arrow delta:C→Res(q_n)Cprime whose realized arrow, followed by the derived square and Res(eprime), equals e followed by the actual restricted transition has universal etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow on every etale Z-object V [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows, def-weil-pbc-etale-universal-normalization]. This is LisseTowerScalarSquareReflects. In addition, every universal algebraic arrow k:E→Res(q_n)Eprime has a universal constant normalization arrow after the same etale restriction, as specified by LisseTowerConstantLocalUniversal. No descended transition, further local realization, restriction-coherence equation or stalk assertion is constructed.

proof.text: The completion quotient maps commute with consecutive quotients. Naturality of the constant ring comparison and of inverse image gives the square for the two ordinary coefficient presentations. Both module sheaves are sheafifications of the same additive presheaf with the same restricted action. The identity on that presheaf therefore extends uniquely to a natural isomorphism. After forgetting scalars it is exactly the composite of the abelian sheafification counits specified by LisseTowerScalarSquareSections. Faithfulness of the forgetful functor proves uniqueness.

Both ordinary realization functors are exact equivalences. Apply exact localization and its composition comparison, then paste with the coefficient square of comparison inverse image. This is exactly lisseTowerEtaleScalarIso. The inverse scalar mate for realization is invertible because its transverse functors are equivalences. For comparison and inverse image, compute scalar extension on flat resolutions. Both orders are sheafifications of the same balanced tensor, and the identity of pure tensors identifies the mate and its inverse. The unit is m↦1 tensor m, so the comparisons have the specified unit normalization. On actual ringed coefficients this agrees with the ring-sheaf-change adjunction by its adjunct identity.

Take the scalar adjunct of delta. The assumed descent equation and the mate unit identities identify its image with the pulled actual normalization isomorphism of M, conjugated by e and eprime. Hence that image is invertible. Comparison is exact and conservative: on homology its sheaf unit is invertible, so it detects a zero cone. The fixed realization is an equivalence. These two functors therefore reflect invertibility of the adjunct, which proves the stated global universality. This uses no bounded Tor dimension and includes zero rings, zero complexes and empty schemes. Pullback to an etale Z-object has the same invertible scalar mate, computed by the same sheafified flat-resolution tensor identity. Its unit identity identifies the pulled universal arrow with the prescribed etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow. Thus this arrow is universal on every source. Exactness preserves the bounds needed by the source-site comparison.

For an algebraically universal k, exact constant realization is universal by normalizationConstantArrow_isUniversal. Pull it to each etale source by the same tensor computation and unit identity. This proves LisseTowerConstantLocalUniversal. Restriction coherence is not included in this lemma and is proved independently by lem-weil-pbc-etale-normalization-coherence.

lean.statement:
theorem lisseTower_scalar_restriction {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃! c : LisseTowerScalarSquare f d n,
      LisseTowerScalarSquareSections f d n c ∧ LisseTowerScalarSquareReflects f d n c ∧
        LisseTowerConstantLocalUniversal Z d n
